references.text: Moses gave the command to strike the enemies with the ban (herem), which Joshua carries out here
Moses' command to devote to destruction (herem) all who live in the cities that the Lord gives Israel
The command to drive out all the inhabitants of the land and destroy their cities
Joshua devoted Jericho and everything in the city to destruction, an earlier example of herem practice
Joshua conquered Ai and struck all its inhabitants with the edge of the sword, a similar action
Joshua's conquest of the southern cities where he defeated the kings and devoted the inhabitants to destruction with the edge of the sword
Confirmation that Joshua did everything the Lord had commanded Moses, and Moses had commanded Joshua
Explanation that the Lord hardened the enemies' hearts so they could be devoted to destruction
